title: Extreme AI anxiety as a senior programmer
author: TashLai
selftext:
Are there any professional programmers here who tried vibe coding games specifically? Because whenever i try, i eventually hit the "i don't understand what's going on under the hood and the last feature i requested resulted in 50 000 loc i won't be reviewing thank you very much" roadblock.

Now, i absolutely love programming. But i also feel like it's not helping me much. Manual programming feels like a massive waste of time and deliberately falling behind for no reason at all. When i try AI-assisted coding, i mostly feel like a backseat driver. Like, AI is perfectly adequate and doesn't really need me poking the code all the time. Vibe coding just starting to feel like the right thing to do and it's also the thing i simply cannot do.

I spent 20 years learning one skill that made me valuable as a productive member of society. And now what, i just let it go? 

I really envy people who never learned programming, because now they can simply tell claude or sol to write code for them and never worry about whether the architecture is good, how is this map represented and will it bite me in the future, things like that. And they actually end up releasing games! While i'm sitting here in total paralysis.

Sorry, it's just something i needed to get off my chest. I feel like a dinosaur who sees a rock falling from the skies and just stands there not knowing what to do now.
